description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes for F1AP protocol messages, including procedures, PDUs, and related containers, used in 3GPP telecommunications specifications.

classes.name: f1ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the F1AP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with methods to set and get different message types such as initiation, success, and failure responses.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an initiating message in the F1AP protocol, including procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful outcome message in the F1AP protocol, including procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful outcome message in the F1AP protocol, including procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: f1ap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Defines the set of elementary procedures (messages) in the F1AP protocol, including various request, response, and failure message types.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of the message (e.g., init_msg, successful_outcome, etc.) in the F1AP PDU.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer for transmission.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes data from a bit buffer into the message structure.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format for easier inspection or logging.
